title: Concurrent loopback HTTP adapter

claims.text: serve binds ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1, forces tool authority with http transport, mints a session token, announces the startup port on stderr and the loopback url on stdout, and serves until SIGINT or SIGTERM.

_route authorizes Host/Origin/session before any API handling, maps _STATUS from error codes to HTTP statuses, refuses fixture mutations with fixture_readonly, and exposes only /api/health, /api/tools, /api/call and /api/events plus static assets.

_dispatch accepts only the frozen {untrusted} success seam or {ok:false,code,detail} errors (detail 1..2048 chars), and _body enforces exact JSON media, Content-Length cap 1048576, and a closed {tool,args} body shape.

triggers: fixture_readonly on protected call in fixture mode

decision.rule: Change here when loopback binding, session authorization, route table, or the dispatch result seam needs to change.
decision.failure: A foreign-origin mutation is authorized, a fixture mode serves live writes, or a legacy dispatch result is silently adapted.

questions.q: Where does _route map domain error codes to HTTP statuses?
Where should I change which API paths the loopback adapter exposes?
Where can I debug why a fixture-mode protected call returns fixture_readonly?
